name: Agries Melisses
description: Every time a daughter was born, the father of Eleni, Asimina and Froso planted a poplar tree at the edge of their orchard to commemorate the arrival of the new child. As they grew and grew tall and slender, he boasted of them as his daughters. In the proudest poplar, however, Helen's poplar, a swarm of wild bees had already nested. "You will be happy, my daughter, and life will be as sweet as this honey. You'll see," her father used to tell her. But, the years passed and Eleni looked at the poplar and listened to the hum... "How do you know, father... How do you know that life has written only bitterness for my root".

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Thessalian Plain, 1958. Three sisters, three different women. Eleni, Asimina and Droso. After the lost of their father, they stayed without support. One wedding proposition comes as a holy gift for Eleni.  But, at the first night of her wedding, she and her sisters will paint their hands with blood...

Asimina will receive an unexpected visit in her hiding place

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview:
Eleni proceeds with the complaint against Voskari, placing her hopes in the help of Grammatikos. Nikiforos is shocked by the revelation about Drosa's past and informs Asimina that the agreement is broken and that her sister will not approach the child again. Drosso learns about the new disaster caused by Takis and everyone is afraid that the news is a matter of hours to go around Diafani.

The relationship between Angelos and Nestor is shaken after the revelations about Cypriot, while Georgette's arrival fills the house of Sevasti with joy, but causes great jealousy in Penelope. Tollias and Pagona are in despair with the impending marriage of Sofoula and Voskari, but an unexpected event seems to end their own martyrdom and that of Eleni

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview:
Boscaris is taken to the prosecutor. Sofoula gets along with Eleni and ignores Angelos who tries to open her eyes. Eleni's revelation about what she went through in prison, gives her the final blow and she feels alone and cut off from everyone. Konstantis, to everyone's surprise, will defend Droso who is being insulted by her fellow villagers. What will happen when Nikiforos catches them in the leech?

Ourania, despite the disagreement with Kyriakos, closes the agreement with Tsambardis and together with Rizo and Violeta they start to set up the craft in her house. The Duke, while preparing the ground to become king of the plain again, will be in front of Themelis. Meletis spends time with Georgette, causing Penelope to be jealous. Grammatikos informs Eleni that they must find other women to testify against Voskari, when the appearance of someone at the police station will bring ups and downs

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview:
Eleni and Lambros are anxious, all their hopes are left, now, to Grammatikos and the other women who were abused by Voskaris. Droso is happy to work in Ourania's new business venture, but once again, Takis will spoil her joy. Asimina and Myrsini will come into conflict after a decision that has to do with Sergio.

The Duke agrees to cooperate with Socrates, a fact that will provoke the wrath of Constantine and the Study. Eleni and Lambros accept the agreement that Nikiforos has brought to the Cooperative, despite the bad feeling that they have. Voskaris manages to involve Eleni in the murder of Georgalas and Nestoras decides to proceed with an act of self-sacrifice to save her

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview:
Where will Nestor's act of self-sacrifice lead and what will be the next move of Voskari? Asimina and Droso are forced to put aside for a while what separates them, for the sake of their sister. Doukas deals with Myrsini who got involved with Voskari.

Meletis visits Themelis and asks him why he is again involved in the work of Doukas. Grammatikos tries to persuade Maduro to testify against Voskari. Meletis decides to take the next step with Georgette. How will Penelope react?

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Matthew's appearance to the prosecutor will turn the tables… Boscaris is called to apologize. Will he be able to save her this time? Alexis fails to extract the testimonies he wants from the victims of Voskari and everything shows that the case leads to a wreck. Asimina takes a small step towards Droso, provoking Myrsini's rage. Urania is dynamically entering its new business venture but the first clouds appear at home. Georgette decides to openly claim the Study. Will she manage to pull him out of his love with Penelope? Annette and Eleni will receive an unexpected visit and a wedding will take place secretly, causing new upheavals…

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: The disappearance of Sofoula and Voskaris causes unrest in the village Μι Miltiadis suspects that Nikiforos and Doukas will set a trap in the cooperative and on the day they are preparing to sign the new statute of the cooperative, Miltiadis decides to dissolve the of his brother. Will he manage to convince the others? The secret bond between Drosos and Konstantis will come to the notice of someone who is known for the troubles he causes. The relationship between Meletis and Georgette does not start with the best omens. Myrsini is shocked when she discovers the real plans of Doukas for their wedding, while Eleni and Lambros will be informed by Alexis, a huge subversive development…

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Myrsini does not intend to accept the divorce and leave the house without a fight Ν Nikiforos takes the reins of the cooperative while Miltiadis is angry that they did not listen to him. Konstantis and Droso struggle with what separates them, putting forward their love. Voskaris learns that he will go to trial and breaks out in Sofoula. But she still refuses Angelos' help. The Study removes Georgette from him while Annette urges him to have contact with his sister, Domna, but to keep it a secret. Everyone is next to Eleni who is looking forward to ending with Voskaris Μι Miltiadis proposes to Violeta but a fight between Meletis and Miltiadis will evoke unpleasant memories in everyone. Nikiforos brings a tough agreement with Ignatiadis to be signed.What will be the reaction of the members of the cooperative?

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: The members of the cooperative understand the real intentions of Nikiforos who signs the agreement despite their objections. The divorce of Doukas and Myrsini falls like a bomb on the house of Sevasti. Everyone is trying to learn the word and prevent the Duke who is adamant. Will Boscaris' threat unite the couple again? Miltiadis tries to convince Lambros, Violeta and Annette that the incident with the Study was insignificant, while Eleni reveals in the village what happened in the prison in the hands of Boskaris causing unrest. The whole village is opposite Voskari which is trying to be caught from somewhere. Themelis catapults Meletis once again, implying that Domna uses him. Konstantis helps Drosso see Sergio, while Eleni tries to help Madourou find her husband again.How will he react to Voskari?

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview:
Eleni and the whole cooperative are upset with the revelation of Konstantis, that Doukas is behind the agreement with Ignatiadis and they decide to send a delegation, led by Eleni, to deal with him and the conflict will be fierce.

Nikiforos feels that he has been defeated in the worst way and the house of Sevaston is one step before the final dissolution. Marcos will not leave things to chance after what he saw. Will he reveal to Alexis about the kiss that Penelope exchanged with Meletis?

Asimina and Droso will have an unexpected meeting. Myrsini returns from the hospital and tries to find out what is happening with Konstantis. Will they manage to keep his relationship with Drosso secret from her? At the same time, Konstantis and Droso will each make a different decision about their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview:
The Duke shows all the members of the cooperative his intentions. Nikiforos, overwhelmed by the deception of his father, cannot react, while Eleni is once again confronted by Doukas.

Myrsini learns about Konstantis and Droso and becomes furious with her son. But she is determined to keep their home upright. Konstantis tries to find a way to be with Droso, but she makes serious decisions about their relationship.

Sofoula settles into their new home with Voskari who implements his plan to win his own νε Penelope has to explain to her father-in-law the kiss with Meletis while a child from Polis, Eftychis comes to disturb her life of Miltiades and Violeta. A meeting of the Duke with Themelis will lead to revelations Ε Eleni will learn a new thing that will shock her.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview:
The news of a murder will lead Eleni to collapse… All eyes will fall on the most likely culprit… But will the truth shine?

Violeta persuades Prousalis to keep Eftychis for a few days, who seems to be winning the heart of the village. But will he beat Miltiadis as well?

Nikiforos decides to go on the counterattack and block the Duke's plan… Penelope reveals to Alexis the kiss she exchanged with Meletis. How will Alexis react? Sofoula will see a different face from Boscaris while an unexpected visit may prove to be her salvation.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview:
In the house of Sevaston they have to manage another storm… the separation of Penelope and Alexis… Everyone is trying to find out the cause and soon they will reach the hard truth…

Marcos tries to change Alexis' mind while Sophoula, who is slowly seeing the true face of Boscaris, receives an unexpected visit from someone who tries to persuade her to follow him. Will he make it this time?

Eleni thinks for the first time to give up and withdraw her testimony, when Voskaris and his lawyer offer her a compromise solution. Will Eleni agree to leave the battle?

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Eleni denies Voskari's compromise and is determined to make it to the end, while Lambros expresses his own desire for what they will do with their lives. Nikiforos tries to ruin the Duke's plans but falls into a dead end once again. Asimina between him, the child and Drosso is desperately trying to find a balance. The whole village is busy with the arrival of Eftychis in their lives and Violeta is determined to keep him but Miltiadis's situation worries Lambros and tries to prevent them. Droso suggests to Kyriakos to write him a song while Konstantis despite their separation continues to support her in Myrsini who tries to bring him with her waters. An unexpected development puts Penelope in front of her dilemma. Alexis the Study.While at the same time Sofoula is preparing for her flight… Will Voskaris manage to pop it before he gets hit?

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: For the first time in its history, Diafani is going through a day that will not look like any other. The armistice extends from side to side while the Stamirenes and the Sevasti each live in their own home a great joy. Nothing seems capable of overshadowing this day. Or maybe not;

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Boscaris and Sofoula's visit to his in-laws will worry them the most as they see a change in their daughter. An unpleasant event in the house of Grammatikos will overshadow the happy news of Penelope εγκ's pregnancy… And Meletis, however, finds it difficult to manage the news about this child. Droso and Konstantis decide to continue to be seen secretly while Koula and Nontas get to know the village better. Miltiadis and Violeta decide to adopt Eftychis. But will he accept it? Nikiforos sinks into his grief for what his father did to him and suggests to Asimina to leave. Doukas feels that he is misunderstood by everyone while he proceeds his plans with Themelis patiently. Will Themelis find out how the Duke knows his secret?A new problem breaks out in the house of Sevasti, when Sergios finds the newspaper clippings from Eleni's own.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: The truth about Eleni has shaken Sergio. The explosion of Myrsini pours more oil on the fire but it seems unrepentant despite the criticism of the whole family. The situation leads Asimina to seriously consider Nikiforos' proposal to leave for Paris. Violeta is determined to proceed with the adoption of Eftychis despite Lambros' concerns but Miltiadis feels that his son is against him. But Eftychis will go and find Lambros to clarify it. Themelis learns that his secret has been revealed and decides to act. Will he face the Duke directly or will he disappear? Kula stands next to Droso who fights between the love for her son and her relationship with Konstantis. Nestoras comes face to face with the past as he accepts the visit of Nikolaidis.Is it time for the brigadier to assume his responsibilities?
